assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's one curated REVIEWED item at basis_commit, read end to end with its front matter: the canonical V2 character monograph series/gakuen-idolmaster/07_DEFINITIVE_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPHS/GKM_HIWATARI_KANAE.md (22,308 bytes; status canonical, empty supersession arrays, veto false), a self-contained portrait of Hiwatari Kanae through the Japanese Dear 000-010, the admitted Produce Series 001 variants and endings, the first solo song communication and contemporary support stories at Source Lock 1.2 revision 88, with China-track scenes kept to their own source states. It is located by Japanese script name and line range (its Source routes table), by Dear number, and by matched audiovisual edition and offset (SRC-0023, SRC-0059, SRC-0125, SRC-0131). At this basis the monograph carries the 3b19c73b correction of the song communication's pre-stage sequence (her centering breaths at SRC-0059 446.7-451.4 s heard against the crowd cheers, and the instrumental returning around 454.25 s as she explains how her former self would have reacted); no claim rests on the superseded wording. The SL1.2 source-facing reading, Relationship Systems II, the dedicated audiovisual package, the Carbon reconciliation, the residual register and the project's qualification record are not curated on this subject; no claim rests on them, and the qualification record's COMPLETE_AT_BOUNDARY label was not adopted as a grade. No primary source script or recording was inspected for this assessment.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Kanae's story through Dear 010 at Source Lock 1.2 revision 88, in located states: the childhood appeal to China's grandfather and the young China's call (China's report and Kanae's memory, Dear 000-001); the attendant before the transfer (support 1-0013); the transfer proposal and examination (Dear 001 L474-639); the newsletter shoot, the Wonder Scale refusal and the sound-check fragment of 初 (Dear 004-006); the greenhouse turn and the run (Dear 008 L433-723), which splits the arc into before (seeking to give up the advancement assessment to stay with China) and after (stating she wants to be an idol); the advancement assessment (Dear 009); the post-assessment state (Dear 010). Produce Series 001 endings (failure, normal, True; lettered A-E) are alternate conditional outcomes, not later states, and the song communication has no fixed calendar placement after Dear 010. China-track memories of earlier Kanae (Dear kcna 023-024, communication kcna-3-016) keep their own source states; the exact earlier China Produce route is open. Nothing after Dear 010 is in scope.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution) and the owner's A/B boundary direction of 24 November 2026 in PR #694, not yet recorded in the policy: A turns on the integration, individuation and transferability of the model within a declared scope; interpretations that predict the same behavior may coexist; divergent transfer conditions, missing evidence and unsettled dispositions are named and excluded rather than counted against the tier; held-out validation, analytical derivation, relationship labels and preserved source chronology are not barriers. Evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The opening section and 'Work she chose' give an organizing principle with a revisable premise: she organizes choice around a person she took seriously before she could name a career (the childhood appeal despite household rank; going out on days off to see China smile; the young China's call taken as purpose, Dear 000-001), and she applies that capacity to the wrong question when she assumes China must want someone who suppresses every ambition of her own. The greenhouse (Dear 008) revises that premise when the Producer relays China's wish; Dear 010 shows service, rivalry and her own aim held together. The mutual-withholding pattern (each woman thinks hard about what the other needs and withholds what the other needs to answer) predicts errors, not only prudence. Not A: one compact portrait; each modifier in the Conditional behavioral profile rests on one or two scenes; the post-Dear 010 balance of service and ambition is unshown. Not C: the evidence names what changes her response (an explicit account of China's wish, demonstrated results, scale of exposure, branch failure) and predicts her mistakes (misreading China's wish, China as sole audience, training past a sensible point).

The Dear chain gives located states with causes: attendant scrutiny before the transfer; acceptance of the service framing for enrolment (Dear 001 L474-639); exposure fear at the shoot and sound check (Dear 004-006); the wish to give up the assessment, then the greenhouse admission of fear and of wanting to be an idol and the urgent run (Dear 008 L433-723); the assessment (Dear 009); jealousy-like admission, delegation of part of China's support and the first-person ambition (Dear 010 L68-91, L199-247, L369-373). Not A: the post-assessment state rests on a few Dear 010 spans; Produce endings are alternate outcomes, not ordered states; the song communication is unplaced. Not C: the decisive change is located inside Dear 008 with stated before and after, and the monograph separates the transfer exam from the advancement assessment.

'Ordinary conduct, formal speech' gives register rules: first person usually 私; お嬢様 for China; professional politeness framing an ultimatum, a narrow request or a playful retreat toward the Producer; recognizing a challenger before Nadeshiko's introduction finishes; polite endings kept as the greenhouse sentence breaks into hesitant clauses; more urgent plain-form inner wording in the run (voice assets at Dear 008 L711, L723); the SRC-0023 4125-4132 s heard あなた様と共に against the displayed プロデューサー様と共に. Delivery is scene-specific; no stable vocal profile is asserted. Not B: few quoted lines, no line inventory, and the monograph states that written deference gives no reliable estimate of how strongly she feels, so the register constrains form but not intensity. Not D: the address, politeness and inner-outer contrasts are located and individuated.

Ordinary conduct is located by example: fixing China's hair, checking supplies and making breakfast before her own school day (support 1-0013_01 L8-143 and _02 L69-161); running with China; struggling to name a favorite food when asked directly (Dear 003 L109-140) but arguing for vegetables and protein and choosing a hamburger with China (support 3-0115_02 L87-172); balking at a slogan for her own costume; branch-selected Produce encounters (a lozenge, a walk, housework talk, karaoke); fan-club work as duty and hobby. The monograph limits finance, broad diet, medical constraints and life outside school or China. Not B: single-instance habits and branch-selected scenes. Not D: the instances are located and the food case distinguishes a practical preference from an enduring favorite.

Ties are read in both directions and staged. China: perception-driven service, pride and fear of being left behind at the H.I.F. win, China as the audience whose approval decides a scene (the Nadeshiko episode, where China's correction revises Kanae's assumption), the best-seat rivalry kept after delegation (Dear 010). The Producer: competence-judging and narrowly businesslike in China-track memory (kcna 023-024, kcna-3-016); a limited contract with a threat to report neglect of China (Dear); partial trust and results answered with results in the branch-specific failure ending; entrustment of her idol life in the True ending (true-01 L160-259); delegation of part of China's support (Dear 010). Nadeshiko: theatrical challenge met with a precise formal reply. Not A: Nadeshiko, the grandfather and classmates are thinly sampled, and China-track witnesses are another character's memory. Not C: trust follows demonstrated results and delegation follows trust, located across stages.

Interior evidence is located at a few points: pride and fear at China's H.I.F. win; the greenhouse statements that being watched frightens her and that she wants to be an idol; the scripted inner voice of the run with assigned voice assets (Dear 008 L711, L723); the song communication's interior approach to the stage (feeling freer, stepping out from the shade of her sun). The monograph says the audio contrast supports a change in what she does but not the accent of every interior line. Not B: interior access is sparse outside Dear 008 and the song communication. Not D: the decisive decision is given from inside.

Located modes: polite conditions with a sanction toward an authority over China (the report threat); the precise formal reply to Nadeshiko's challenge; refusing a particular request (Wonder Scale at the shoot, jokingly giving faith as reason) while fulfilling a limited one (the sound-check fragment); objecting to one slogan while taking China's contribution seriously; continued rivalry with the Producer framed as not sulking. Not B: one or two scenes per mode; open confrontation with China or a peer is unshown. Not D: each mode carries its trigger.

The located weighing is between loyalty to China and her own wish (the wish to move to the General Department, then the greenhouse revision, Dear 008) and the consent asymmetry of the transfer framing, which the monograph presents through the Producer's framing, accepted by her as her own reason, rather than as a staged deliberation (Dear 001 L474-639). No moral dilemma outside that duty-and-wish frame is shown. Not C: one located deliberation, about her own course rather than a right or wrong toward others. Not E: that deliberation is staged with its reasons.

Local instances only: faith given jokingly as the reason to decline Wonder Scale; a playful retreat from an awkward admission to the Producer; the karaoke encounter; fan-club work as hobby. The monograph gives no account of her humor's function or range. Not D: too few instances to be distributed.

One compact, independently reviewed portrait routes each responsibility to Japanese scripts by line range and names its matched recordings, with the Produce B/D native display, wrapper grades and SAA-213 kept open. It does not reproduce a line inventory, and the earlier SL1.2 reading, the audiovisual package and Relationship Systems II are not curated on this subject. Not B: one 22 KB derived item without ledgers on the row. Not D: its routes cover the whole declared boundary.

Affirmative limits stated by the monograph: no scene through Dear 010 in which the Producer tells Kanae that China proposed the transfer; she cannot readily name an enduring favorite food; her costume objection is particular, not a general aversion; cooperation does not guarantee consent to every presentation; the failure ending shows incomplete trust; the jealousy-like admission is assigned no genre or exclusive romantic meaning. Several other limits are absences (pay, finance, medical, life outside school). Not B: few located contradictions of overgeneralization. Not D: those that exist are explicit and located.

States are located by Dear number and line range, and the transfer exam and the advancement assessment are kept apart; the Produce variants are conditional outcomes, China-track scenes keep their own source states, and the song communication has no fixed calendar placement. Not B: no calendar dates, and the post-Dear 010 order of the song and Produce material is open. Not D: the Dear chain's order and the located turn are explicit.

conditions: Output is illustrative written Japanese, never quotation; no stable vocal profile, accent or performed delivery is claimed (SRC observations are scene-specific).
First person 私; お嬢様 for China; professional politeness toward the Producer, which may carry a condition, a narrow request or a playful retreat.
Polite endings persist under hesitation (Dear 008 greenhouse); urgent plain-form wording is for inner voice (the run).
State is named: before Dear 008 she frames aims as service to China; after it she can state a first-person aim with China still in mind (Dear 010).
The interlocutor is China, the Producer or Nadeshiko as sampled; another classmate or adult is a separate, lower-confidence condition limited to the politeness rules.
Do not infer depth of feeling from politeness level; the monograph says written deference gives no reliable estimate.
scenario_readiness.note: The address, politeness and inner-outer rules constrain illustrative written Japanese to China, the Producer or Nadeshiko in a named Dear state closely enough for bounded use. Intensity is not constrained by written deference, and no vocal delivery is claimed.

conditions: China needs something China has not seen yet: predict prompt practical help, possibly coordinated behind the scenes; a trusted explicit account of what China herself wants can redirect her (Dear 008).

Someone claims authority to support China: predict a competence check, polite direct conditions and possibly a right to report neglect; delegation of a named part of the job follows demonstrated results (Dear 010), not assurances.

Praise or attention falls on her: predict questioning why it belongs to her and looking to China's reaction (the Nadeshiko episode); before Dear 008, retreat or deletion requests (the walking footage); after it, the attribution can be taken openly when she has prepared and someone recognizes her wish.

Duty to China competes with her own stage: before Dear 008, predict retreat toward proximity (the General Department wish); after it, predict pursuit of the stage framed as compatible with China and a search for a trusted delegate. In a failure-branch state, the defensive contract or a wish to retreat can return.
A song or look contradicts her self-image: predict asking whether it is a mistake, taking the contributor seriously and testing it by practice; a particular rendition or slogan can still be refused.
Include her mistakes: assuming China wants her ambition suppressed, relying on China as sole audience, training past a sensible point, and withholding what the other needs to answer.
Knowledge boundary: through Dear 010 she has not been told that China proposed the transfer; she knows China's wish only as the Producer relays it.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state from the temporal boundary: before the transfer; Dear 001 to Dear 007; Dear 008 before or after the greenhouse; Dear 009; Dear 010; or one named Produce Series 001 ending as an alternate outcome. Her childhood appeal and the young China's call belong to her at every state; China's transfer proposal stays unknown to her in every state through Dear 010.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: China as the person she serves, admires, competes to stand beside and depends on as audience; the Producer as tested authority, contracted producer, partial or entrusted ally by state and branch; Nadeshiko as rival challenger. Another student, teacher or adult is a separate, lower-confidence transfer; the grandfather appears only through China's report and the Producer's arrangement; romantic partners are unsampled.
setting_constraints: Hatsuboshi Gakuen and the Kuramoto household as the game presents them at Source Lock 1.2 revision 88: attendant duties, lessons, the Idol Department, the transfer exam, the advancement assessment, newsletter and sound-check work, and the first solo song preparation.

No event after Dear 010, no fixed placement of the song communication, no native B/D result display, no romantic or intimate scene, no finance or medical premise, no cross-series setting, and no outcome invented to settle a prediction.

scenario_readiness.note: Bounded novel scenes inside school, attendant and early idol work can be predicted from the five profile rows and the located Dear states. Post-Dear 010 career, romance and private life outside China and school are excluded.

conditions: Service tasks for China (hair, kit, meals, schedule) and joint choices with China, as in support 1-0013 and 3-0115.
With the Producer: branch-selected small encounters (a lozenge, a walk, housework talk, karaoke) in one named Produce state.
A direct question about her own favorites may meet hesitation; a practical preference in context is supported (Dear 003; support 3-0115_02).
Leisure, finance and life outside school or China are not modeled.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary service and shared choices with China and small exchanges with the Producer are located but sampled by single scenes.

The only staged deliberation is between loyalty to China and her own wish (Dear 008). The evidence gives no moral-dilemma reasoning toward others, so ethical scenarios would be invention beyond the duty-and-wish frame, which CROSS_SCENARIO covers.

The monograph names a jealousy-like response to the Producer's place beside China and explicitly declines to assign it a genre or exclusive romantic meaning; the True ending's entrustment concerns her idol life and licenses no private relationship outcome. Romance scenarios would rest on what the evidence declines to claim.

conditions: Attendant work for China: anticipatory, material and coordinated behind the scenes (support 1-0013; Dear 000-001).
Early idol work: practical knowledge preferred to generic encouragement; limited professional requests fulfilled while exposure frightens her (Dear 004-006); state named before or after Dear 008.

The production contract: limited period, conditions and a report threat; delegation follows results (the production contract in her Dear story; Dear 010; the failure and True endings as alternate outcomes).
No career history after Dear 010, no second original and no measurable vocal development are modeled.
scenario_readiness.note: Attendant service and early idol training under the Producer are located with their conditions.

known_limits.statement: All claims rest on one 22 KB derived portrait; each modifier in its Conditional behavioral profile rests on one or two scenes, and no held-out test of its predictions is reported.

The Dear chain ends at 010 at this boundary; the balance of service, rivalry and her own aim after the advancement assessment rests on a few Dear 010 spans, and the song communication has no fixed placement after Dear 010.

Produce Series 001 failure, normal and True endings are alternate outcomes with different achieved situations; they are not ordered states, and native B/D result banners, wrapper grades and overlapping thresholds remain open.
Through Dear 010 the admitted story contains no scene in which the Producer tells Kanae that China proposed the transfer; she knows China's wish only as he relays it.
Audiovisual observations (SRC-0023, SRC-0059, SRC-0125, SRC-0131) are scene-specific; no stable vocal profile, timbre or longitudinal vocal development is established, and no vocal stem is isolated.
Written deference gives no reliable estimate of how strongly she feels; politeness level cannot be used to infer intensity.

The jealousy-like admission identifies a real attachment condition without a genre or exclusive romantic meaning; the True ending licenses no permanent private relationship outcome or authority over her life outside idol work.

Earlier Kanae conduct toward the Producer (competence-judging, narrowly businesslike) comes from China-track scenes and memory at their own source states; the exact earlier China Produce route is open.
Exact finance, pay, broad dietary preferences, medical constraints and ordinary life unconnected with school or China are limited at this boundary, as the monograph states.

The SL1.2 source-facing reading, Relationship Systems II (the China-Kanae shared Producer state), the dedicated audiovisual package, the Carbon reconciliation and residual register are not curated on this subject; nothing here rests on them.
